mapper.select: SELECT id, name, meta, description, url, repo_url, sort_order, visible, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE visible = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, meta, description, url, repo_url, sort_order, visible, created_at, updated_at FROM project ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (name, meta, description, url, repo_url, sort_order, visible) VALUES (#{name}, #{meta}, #{description}, #{url}, #{repoUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{visible})
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET name = #{name}, meta = #{meta}, description = #{description}, url = #{url}, repo_url = #{repoUrl}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, visible = #{visible} WHERE id = #{id}
